# search_user_outings

## Purpose

List the outings (trip reports) a Camptocamp user is listed on as a participant, not only those they wrote, most recent first. The user ID is the number in the user's camptocamp.org profile URL. It is an alias of [`search_outings`](search_outings.md) with only `user_id`, `limit`, `offset` and `lang`, and returns exactly what `search_outings` returns for the same `user_id` and `lang`.

## Inputs

| Parameter | Type    | Required | Default | Constraints |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `user_id` | integer | yes      |         | > 0         |
| `limit`   | integer | no       | `10`    | 1 to 50     |
| `offset`  | integer | no       | `0`     | ≥ 0         |
| `lang`    | string  | no       |         |             |

- `user_id`: Camptocamp user ID (the number in their profile URL): outings this user is listed on as a participant, not only those they wrote.
- `limit`: Maximum number of results.
- `offset`: Number of results to skip, for paging (offset + limit ≤ 10,000).
- `lang`: Language of titles and texts, one of: fr, en, de, it, es, ca, eu, sl, zh (default fr). Values: `fr`, `en`, `de`, `it`, `es`, `ca`, `eu`, `sl`, `zh`

## Related tools
